title: Oil spills, 1970-2016
original_source_line: Source: Our World in Data, Roser 2016r, based on data (updated) from the International Tanker Owners Pollution Federation.
book_definition_note: Oil spills include all losses of at least 7 metric tons of oil. Oil shipped consists of total crude oil, petroleum product, and gas loaded.

raw_downloads.role: rejected oil-shipping candidate for book-period line; starts in 2000 and fails RMT scale check

transformations: Filtered OWID data to World and computed oil_spills_7_plus_tonnes as medium plus large tanker spills.
Downloaded current UNCTADStat US.SeaborneTrade bulk metadata and archive; extracted World cargo types 11 and 12 as a rejected diagnostic successor only.
Compared current UNCTAD bulk cargo 11+12 values against UNCTAD Review of Maritime Transport 2020 selected-year tanker-trade values.

accepted_series.series: Oil spills of at least 7 tonnes
accepted_series.coverage: 1970-2016 book period; 1970-2025 current successor for spill-count-only extension
accepted_series.source: Our World in Data grapher number-oil-spills.csv, citing ITOPF
accepted_series.tolerance: Exact row-level sum of OWID medium and large spill columns.

rejected_or_unresolved_series.series: Oil shipped by sea / tanker trade
rejected_or_unresolved_series.current_best_evidence: UNCTADStat US.SeaborneTrade current bulk file is publicly downloadable but labeled From 2000 to 2024.
rejected_or_unresolved_series.reason_not_plotted: It lacks 1970-1999 and differs from RMT 2020 tanker-trade selected years by roughly 31-48 percent on overlap; therefore it is not a comparable book-line source.
No archived OWID/Roser data bundle, archived UNCTADStat export, or ITOPF chart-data table with annual 1970-2016 oil-shipping values was recovered in this run.

candidate_evidence.source: UNCTAD Review of Maritime Transport 2020 Table 1.1
candidate_evidence.limitation: Selected years only; not the exact annual 1970-2016 series.

candidate_evidence.source: This run's comparison of current UNCTADStat bulk data against RMT 2020 selected years
candidate_evidence.limitation: Shows non-comparability of current bulk cargo 11+12 values for the book gray line.

extension_policy: Only the spill-count series is extended, using the same OWID/ITOPF successor source through 2025. No oil-shipping extension is plotted.
unresolved_issues: Exact Roser 2016r data snapshot not located.
The book-period visual cannot be described as a verified reconstruction because the gray right-axis line is intentionally absent.
